item.title: US calls India ‘Very Good Actor’ amid temporary waiver on Russian crude; Know why
item.description: The United States has signaled it may temporarily ease sanctions on some Russian oil to stabilize global energy markets. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent praised India for cooperating with earlier restrictions and stopping purchases of sanctioned Russian crude.

item.title: Cooking gas gets costlier as LPG cylinder prices increase across India; Details here
item.description: India has increased LPG cylinder prices nationwide, raising domestic 14.2 kg cooking gas cylinders by ₹60 and commercial 19 kg cylinders by ₹115. In Delhi, the price of a domestic cylinder has gone up to ₹913. The hike will impact households as well as businesses such as hotels and restaurants.

item.title: Trump announces plan to quadruple US weapons production amid Iran tensions; Details here
item.description: US President Donald Trump has announced plans to significantly increase America’s weapons production amid escalating tensions in the Middle East involving Iran and Israel.

item.title: US to deploy Merops anti-drone system in Middle East against Iranian threat; Here’s how it works
item.description: The United States is preparing to deploy the Merops anti-drone system in the Middle East to counter the growing threat of Iranian drones. Officials say the technology proved effective against drone attacks in Ukraine.

item.title: Nitish Kumar’s son Nishant Kumar meets Senior JD(U) leaders ahead of official entry into Party
item.description: Nishant Kumar, son of Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, held a meeting with senior JD(U) leaders and young MLAs ahead of his official entry into the party. The meeting discussed the party’s future strategy as Nitish Kumar prepares to move to the Rajya Sabha.

item.title: Ram Rahim gets relief in Chhatrapati murder case, HC maintains life term for three other
item.description: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has acquitted Dera Sacha Sauda chief Gurmeet Ram Rahim in the 2002 murder case of journalist Ramchandra Chhatrapati. The court, however, upheld the life imprisonment of three other convicts - Kuldeep Singh, Nirmal Singh and Krishan Lal.

item.title: Why Gold is cheaper in Dubai even as global markets brace for price surge; Details here
item.description: Rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are beginning to impact global markets, but an unusual trend has emerged in Dubai’s bullion market. Gold is being sold at discounts of up to $30 per ounce due to export disruptions and weak tourist demand.

item.title: India allows Iranian warship IRIS Lavan to dock at Kochi port amid rising Middle East tensions
item.description: India has allowed the Iranian warship IRIS Lavan to dock at Kochi port after it developed technical issues while operating in the region. The 183-member crew has been provided temporary accommodation at Indian naval facilities.

item.title: Dhurandhar 2 Trailer Out: Ranveer Singh’s Hamza looks deadly; Intense dialogues and high-octane action unveiled
item.description: The highly anticipated Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge trailer is out, showcasing Ranveer Singh as Hamza in a fierce and dangerous avatar. The 3-minute 25-second trailer is packed with high-octane action, intense dialogues, and thrilling drama.

item.title: UP Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya’s helicopter makes emergency landing; Know what happened
item.description: Uttar Pradesh Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya narrowly escaped a potential disaster when his helicopter faced a technical glitch and smoke filled the cabin during takeoff.
